hook: CM asks Telangana to use water carefully for *8 months*
hook_b: CM asks Telangana to use water carefully for *8 months*
tldr: At the Climate Conclave curtain raiser, the CM urged careful water use for eight months due to El Nino, told farmers to avoid water-heavy crops and announced free EV conversion for 2 lakh diesel autos.

beats.what: CM Revanth Reddy on Friday urged people not to waste water over the next eight months, citing El Nino-driven low rainfall and drought.
beats.why: His office's release said dry conditions and no rains are expected for the next 8 months.
beats.care: He asked farmers to avoid water-heavy crops, and said food grains will not run short for the next two years.

effects.label: Farmers told to avoid thirsty crops
2 lakh autos to go electric free

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The CM said city infrastructure was designed for 2 cm of rain while Hyderabad sometimes gets 24 cm in two hours. Diesel RTC buses are also to be phased out of the city. Timelines for the auto conversion were not given.

cards.q: Eight dry months ahead: what should come first?

qs: How will the free conversion of 2 lakh autos be funded?
Which crops count as water-heavy for this season?

facts.t: Hyderabad sometimes gets *24 cm* of rain in two hours, the CM said.

viz.l: Rain city drains were built for vs what falls
viz.verdict: Per the CM, cloudbursts far exceed the design benchmark, flooding colonies.

steps.e: No food grain shortage, CM says
2 lakh diesel autos to EV, free

viz.verdict: Appeal plus plans; no timeline for the EV conversion yet.

cover.label: Of careful water use, CM says

insight: Per his office, dry weather and no rain are expected for the next eight months due to El Nino.

learn.t: El Nino = a warming of the Pacific Ocean that can weaken India's monsoon.

watch: Climate Conclave at Bharat Future City, December 7-9, and details of the free auto-to-EV conversion.
